librw applies distance fog in its pixel shader (RwRaceSubmit.cpp P7/I4-fog), so D3DRS_FOGENABLE is 0 on its draws by construction; the original uses fixed-function fog (FOGENABLE 1). Fog parameters were matched in I4-fog/P7 and are not measured by this instrument.

librw defaults against RenderWare 3.7's D3D9 driver: every raster flagged alpha (RwRasterBridge creates C8888), ALPHAREF 10 / ALPHAFUNC GREATEREQUAL, CULLMODE NONE (librw d3ddevice.cpp:1787-1800). The original: alpha flag from the raster format (FUN_004d2980) chosen per image (FUN_0054f8d0 -> FUN_004d5340), blend and alpha test switched together (FUN_004d6ce0 at 0x004d6d06, FUN_004d7100), ALPHAFUNC 5 at 0x004d60ec/0x004d6103, ALPHAREF 0 at 0x004d611a/0x004d6123, CULLMODE 2 at 0x004d6157 and per frame in FUN_004492b0. Fix F1 (MASHED_LIBRW_RWSTATES=1) implements this; held default OFF by PREREG rules 1-2 on Arctic (U-9689 sector blending, U-9690 weather cull leak).

Draw order of blended draws against matched draws: the original renders world sectors in RW's traversal order with each sector's atomics, the standalone renders librw's one-clump world in sector-list order and then all instances. U-9694.

TRAINING: 20 of the row's 21 draws lie wholly outside the view frustum; the remaining one (14 tri) has an AABB spanning x -54..156 that straddles it. The original culls that sector. The AABB test cannot show whether any of its triangles is inside the view volume. U-9694.

librw has no frustum culling (World::render -> Clump::render -> Atomic::render, librw world.cpp:134-139, clump.cpp:382-390; Camera::frustumTestSphere at camera.cpp:427 is never called; RwRaceSubmit.cpp draws every instance), the original's RenderWare does. Every draw in the row lies wholly outside the trace row's view frustum (AABB test against the original's M_* frame and view window), so it rasterises nothing.
